metadata.description: Specialist agents and the skills they use, from Get Overpowered. Drafts only: you approve, publish, send and pay.

plugins.name: marketing-lead
plugins.description: A senior marketing role for one person or a small team. It sets your brand voice, plans campaigns, writes the posts and the launch email, briefs the pages Google should find, starts honest conversations with businesses that fit and answers your reviews. Every piece comes back as a draft for you to approve.

plugins.name: product-designer
plugins.description: A senior product design role. It maps how people move through your site or app, plans each page's layout and look, specifies every state of every screen and plans a test with five real people. It plans and reviews; you or your developer build.

plugins.name: sales-lead
plugins.description: A sales and customer role for businesses that sell to other businesses or get reviewed online. It builds a lawful list of businesses that fit, writes short first emails and follow-ups with the rules for your region, and drafts calm replies to reviews with a weekly routine to keep up.
